name: Needham Golf Club
architects: Wayne Stiles (club scorecard 2026: "A Wayne Stiles Design", 1923)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts, flown spring 2021, leaf-off), tile x31y469 (USGS_1M_19_x31y469_MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21.tif, published 2023-01-15), clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py raster; EPSG:26919 (NAD83 / UTM 19N), NAVD88 metres; fetched by the GitHub workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-needham)

laz.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, project MA_CentralEastern_2021_B21 (2021 USGS Lidar: Central Eastern Massachusetts, leaf-off spring 2021), tile 19TCG316681 (x 316500-318000, y 4681500-4683000), classes 3-5 clipped to the world + 100 m by pipeline/intake.py laz; NAD83(2011) / UTM 19N, NAVD88 (Geoid18) metres; fetched by the GitHub workflow 2026-10-31 (release data-needham). The world's top 91 m (y > 4683000, scenery north of the course) is on tile 19TCG316683, whose download timed out: no trees there.
laz.label: 2021 USGS lidar, leaf-off

world.note: OSM course boundary (relation 13156245, two parts) bbox 700 x 690 m (E 316830-317531, N 4682233-4682924) + scenery, rounded out to 4 x 4 chunks of 256 m and centred: about 160 m on every side

join_boundary_parts.note: The OSM boundary (relation 13156245) has two parts 7 m apart across the road between them: holes 7 and 8 north of it, the rest south. Both in play; the game's OB polygon joins them across the road (common.game_boundary); the road strip stays out of bounds on the surface map. No hole plays across it.

scorecard_source: Club scorecard PDF (needhamgolfclub.com/documents/20124/110138/NEEDHAM_2026.pdf, printed 2026, fetched through the GitHub workflow 2026-10-31), agrees with the club's Explore the Course page. Nine holes played twice from different tees: the card's 18 is built as holes 1-18 on the nine greens (holes 10-18 = holes 1-9 from the second-nine tees). Built: Blue/White (par 72, 6,070, men 69.8/129) and White/Green (par 72, 5,848, men 68.5/124); Red/Yellow (ladies 72.0/123) is in scorecard.csv, not built. Blue/Gold (par 70, 6,115, men 70.2/128; hole 8 is a 206-yd par 3 and hole 10 a 401-yd par 4) is not built: the game has one par per hole, so it needs per-tee pars (design request). Stroke index: the men's Blue/White and White/Green row. Full card in scorecard_full.csv.
water_note: The four ponds inside the boundary are OSM natural=water only: red penalty areas through red_water_osm (standing default: all water red; the card's local rules say yellow stakes mark water hazards and red lateral ones, and no source says which pond is which). The MassGIS wooded swamps and wet meadow (natural=wetland, 2007 1:12,000) are not penalty areas: rough and trees, with their lidar ground (flatten_wetlands false).
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2021 Central Eastern Massachusetts lidar)
notes: Overnight build 2026-10-30/31 (developer asleep; calls logged in validation_report.md and docs/courses/needham.md). Standing defaults: all water red, OB = the course boundary, bayside theme, wind 1-9 mph (inland New England).
